raw_block.rationale: Create an airline totaler that avoids the previously unresolved route-table field by having one joint reader classify every current item and return aligned per-item base, overweight, and oversize fees. The deterministic helper applies the higher-of excess-fee rule and adds the ticket price.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What is the current passenger's integer ticket price?

inputs.name: bag_checked_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in its stated order, what base checked-bag fee applies after using the permitted personal-item and carry-on allowances and assigning checked-bag ordinal positions? Return zero for an item carried without a checked-bag fee.

inputs.name: bag_overweight_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, what overweight fee applies under the current route, cabin, weight allowance, and weight band? Return zero when no overweight fee applies.

inputs.name: bag_oversize_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, what oversize fee applies from its summed outside dimensions and the current route's size bands? Return zero when no oversize fee applies.

skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket price plus all current bag fees from aligned per-item checked-bag, overweight, and oversize fee assessments.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all applicable fees for every current bag.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: combined_excess_fee_rule

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

premises.question: When the same bag is both overweight and oversize, which excess fee is added to its checked-bag fee?

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

fields.name: bag_checked_fees
fields.question: What base checked-bag fee applies to each current item in stated order, using zero for a free carried item?

fields.name: bag_overweight_fees
fields.question: What overweight fee applies to each current item in the same order, using zero where none applies?

fields.name: bag_oversize_fees
fields.question: What oversize fee applies to each current item in the same order, using zero where none applies?

reads.question: Using the current itinerary, cabin, bag order, dimensions, weights, allowances, and fee tables, classify every item and return aligned base checked, overweight, and oversize fees.
reads.source_locator: current source native view source_text, facts, and question

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the one-carry-on and one-personal-item allowances before assigning checked-bag ordinal fees.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Determine each bag's size band by adding its length, width, and height.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For a bag that is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher excess fee in addition to its checked-bag fee.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

bag_checked_fees.question: For every current item in its stated order, what base checked-bag fee applies after using the permitted personal-item and carry-on allowances and assigning checked-bag ordinal positions? Return zero for an item carried without a checked-bag fee.

bag_oversize_fees.question: For every current item in the same order, what oversize fee applies from its summed outside dimensions and the current route's size bands? Return zero when no oversize fee applies.

bag_overweight_fees.question: For every current item in the same order, what overweight fee applies under the current route, cabin, weight allowance, and weight band? Return zero when no overweight fee applies.
